verdict.rationale: Martin's docs confirm phone as a first-class interface: users can call Martin and talk live (e.g., dictate notes during a call), and Martin can proactively call users each morning with a spoken briefing, plus general reachability via phone. This establishes real, two-way voice interaction, but there's no independent/community evidence describing the naturalness, latency, or conversational fluidity of these calls. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent reports on voice quality and real-time conversational fluency, technical detail on the voice/telephony stack.
